name: TollNode
summary: Pay-per-call MCP and HTTP tools for AI generation and live data lookups. Hosted at tollnode.com/mcp; discovery tools are free; run_tool is charged only on a usable result via x402 or a prepaid key.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Agentic Solutions Engine, 42 Rustaveli Ave, Batumi, Georgia, per the Terms of Service and imprint). Official Terms (https://tollnode.com/legal/terms, HTTP 200, last updated 10 November 2026) — note https://tollnode.com/terms is HTTP 404 and is not a source. By sending a request to a TollNode endpoint or using the website, you (including any agent acting for you) agree to the terms. You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority where you live. TollNode is designed for businesses, developers and their software agents; mandatory consumer protection law still applies. These terms are governed by the laws of Georgia; the courts of Georgia have exclusive jurisdiction, except where mandatory consumer law gives you the right to bring a claim where you live. You may not use TollNode if you are located in, or ordinarily resident in, a country or region subject to comprehensive EU, UK or US sanctions, or if you or your wallet are listed on a sanctions list (including the OFAC SDN list and EU and UK consolidated lists). The service is pay-per-call access to data and AI tools ("nodes") over HTTP. Each node's price is shown on its page and quoted in the HTTP 402 response before you pay. Payment is in USDC on the Base network, either per call using x402 or from a prepaid account balance. Official wording: a payment is collected only after the node returns a usable result; if a call fails, returns nothing or times out, the payment is not collected. Collected payments are blockchain transactions and are final. You are responsible for your wallet, network fees, taxes, and sending funds on the correct network; they cannot recover funds sent to the wrong network or address. You can use every node without an account. Unused prepaid balance is not refundable, except: (a) EU and UK consumers may withdraw from a top-up within 14 days and get back the part not yet used; (b) if they close your account without you having broken the terms, or stop the service, they refund the unused balance; and (c) where the law requires otherwise. Refunds are paid in USDC on Base to an address you give them. Acceptable use (Terms §5, official wording): you must not use TollNode to create, request or distribute content that is illegal, sexual content involving minors, non-consensual intimate imagery, content that infringes others' rights (including copyright, trademark, privacy and likeness), defamation, harassment, or content intended to deceive people (for example impersonating a real person's voice or likeness without consent, or election misinformation). §7 AI-generated content (official wording): image, audio and similar outputs are generated by AI models; responses mark them as AI-generated (aiGenerated: true), and they don't remove watermarks or provenance data that the underlying models embed. If you publish AI-generated content that could be mistaken for real (for example a realistic image or voice of a person), you are responsible for disclosing that it is AI-generated where the law requires it, including under the EU AI Act. The Terms do not use the word "deepfake". The site footer states model names are trademarks of their owners and TollNode is not affiliated with them. Privacy: https://tollnode.com/legal/privacy (HTTP 200). The GitHub org https://github.com/tollnode returned HTTP 200 but the public repos list was empty, so no repo field is set. Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at https://tollnode.com/mcp. Official initialize instructions (version 1.4.0 when probed): work in three steps (search_tools, get_tool, run_tool); search_tools, get_tool, get_call, list_calls, get_balance and upload_file are free; run_tool is paid and may use x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]) or an account API key (Authorization: Bearer tn_live_…). Tools were not called; no API key, wallet, signature, or spend. Agent docs: https://tollnode.com/agents (HTTP 200; /agents/ 308-redirects to /agents and is not used as url).

agent_access.notes: Bare GET of https://tollnode.com/mcp (and GET with Accept: application/json or text/event-stream) returned HTTP 405 application/json with Allow: POST, OPTIONS and a server-info body (name "TollNode MCP server", transport streamable-http, url https://tollnode.com/mcp). Unauthenticated initialize and tools/list POSTs returned HTTP 200; initialize result serverInfo name tollnode version 1.4.0. tools/list has 7 tools; official descriptions mark search_tools, get_tool, get_call, list_calls, get_balance and upload_file as free, and run_tool as paid (charged only when the call returns a usable result). Tools were not called; no API key, wallet, signature, or spend.
